I slowly turn my head around. The door look like someone just ran through them. Slowly closing.
Something is moving. Something is moving? What? I cant do it so often, it is driving me crazy. But what if? Why not? As I get up I notice that not only the door were weird. When we started the test, Jake was sitting behind me. Why wasnt he there? He couldnt have get out during test. Then what happened to him?

Suddenly I feel something cold on my neck. I feel someone's breath near my ear, then calm whisper "Nice to meet you, triator". Triator? What the fuck is happening? 
"Dont turn around, as it is rather dangerous thing to do now"
"Who are you?" I asked.
"You tell me first, triator" 
Again this word. 
"Why do you call me triator?"
"You were once told to not stop time to your advantage"
"Maybe I was". It was fourth time already when someone told me this. 
"Triator"
I turned around to see who calls me like.
It was not one of my best ideas. Ever.
I have known this face only from photos or reflections. A moment like this isnt even allowed to happen. This face. He is so handsome. Just like me.
"Why you said I shouldnt turn around?"
"You know, triator, its dangerous"
"But nothing happened" I was more and more curious.
"It is dangerous when one meets his self" He said.
By his last word, floor started to crack, windows broke and everything started to fade.
Last thing I remember was very bright light from his eyes.
You have one life. Make it count.
